"""Near-bound batch through submission/main.py; validates JSON round-trip."""
import json, subprocess, sys, os, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('st', '/workspace/dev/stress.py')
st = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(st)

rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)
jobs = [st.big_job(rng, ntrain=10000, nqueries=64, napproved=256),
        st.big_job(rng, ntrain=6000, nqueries=64, napproved=256),
